label: Bible Study
prompt: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly _____ unto all good works.
verse: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
note: The verse after 'all scripture is given by inspiration' — scripture fully equips.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and _____, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verse: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
note: After the flood, God's standing promise: seedtime and harvest, summer and winter — the seasons will keep showing up.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Zadok the priest took an _____ of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verse: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
note: Zadok anointed Solomon from a horn of oil, the trumpet blew, and the people shouted, 'God save king Solomon.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: The harvest is past, the _____ is ended, and we are not saved.
verse: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
note: Harvest came and went and no rescue arrived — the saddest end-of-season line in Scripture.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou _____ over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verse: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
note: From David's last great public prayer: riches and honour come of thee, and 'thou reignest over all.'
